model_organism.citation: Adam21 is dispensable for reproductive processes in mice (PMID: 34631320)
phenotypes: No obvious difference in seminiferous epithelium histology compared with wild-type
No detectable defects in meiotic progression
Sertoli cells and Leydig cells appeared normal
No overt reproductive phenotype; Adam21 is not essential for male fertility in mice

biological.citation: Overexpression of a disintegrin and metalloproteinase 21 is associated with motility, metastasis, and poor prognosis in hepatocellular carcinoma (PMID: 29138461)
biological.summary: siRNA knockdown of ADAM21 in KYN-2 HCC cells, which overexpress it, reduced invasion, migration, proliferation, and in vivo metastasis. ADAM21 positivity in patient tumors was associated with vascular invasion, large tumor size, high grade, and poorer overall and recurrence-free survival. It was an independent prognostic risk factor.
biological.significance: Multivariate analysis: overall survival P=0.003; recurrence-free survival P=0.001

biological.citation: The identification of seven metalloproteinase-disintegrin (ADAM) genes from genomic libraries (PMID: 10524237)
biological.summary: ADAM21 was isolated from a human genomic library as an intronless gene with testis-specific expression. One of the pseudogenes isolated in the same screen evolved from ADAM21.

biological.citation: Expression analysis of the Adam21 gene in mouse testis (PMID: 20117247)
biological.summary: Mouse Adam21 produces two transcript types. Germ cell-specific transcripts contain exons 1 and 2, while exon 2-only transcripts are expressed in testicular somatic cells. An essential promoter and repressive regulatory regions were mapped in transfection assays, and protein was confirmed in testicular somatic cells.

biological.citation: Adam21 is dispensable for reproductive processes in mice (PMID: 34631320)
biological.summary: CRISPR/Cas9 Adam21-null male mice had normal fertility, spermatogenesis, sperm motility, and meiotic progression. Sertoli and Leydig cells were also normal, so Adam21 is not essential for male fertility in mice.

biological.citation: A disintegrin and metalloprotease 21 (ADAM21) is associated with neurogenesis and axonal growth in developing and adult rodent CNS (PMID: 16052496)
biological.summary: ADAM21, unlike the other ADAMs tested, is expressed in adult rodent ependyma and SVZ cells with long basal processes. It is also in early postnatal radial glia, in processes extending into the rostral migratory stream, and in growing axonal tracts and olfactory axons. It colocalizes with OMP but not βIII-tubulin, suggesting a role in neuroblast migration, neurogenesis, and late axonal outgrowth or synapse formation.

biological.citation: TCR variable gene involvement in chromosome inversion between 14q11 and 14q24 in adult T-cell leukemia (PMID: 16520872)
biological.summary: A 14q24 gene near the inversion breakpoint, annotated as an ADAM21 pseudogene, was downregulated in an ATL patient. It was found to be expressed and to encode an ADAM21-like protein, and was named ADAM21-L.

biological.citation: Alpha-Dystrobrevin and its associated proteins in human promyelocytic leukemia cells induced to apoptosis (PMID: 22507200)
biological.summary: ADAM21 was identified by immunoprecipitation with anti-α-dystrobrevin followed by mass spectrometry, as a membrane protein associated with α-dystrobrevin in etoposide-treated HL-60 cells.

biological.citation: Functions of 'A disintegrin and metalloproteases (ADAMs)' in the mammalian nervous system (PMID: 31236626)
biological.summary: This review states that ADAM21, a proteolytic ADAM, functions in regenerative processes after neuronal injury, together with ADAM19.

biological.citation: The ADAMs family: coordinators of nervous system development, plasticity and repair (PMID: 16824663)
biological.summary: This review highlights ADAM21 as uniquely associated with neurogenesis and growing axons in the adult brain, making it a potential target for neural repair.

biological.citation: Recurrent targeted genes of hepatitis B virus in the liver cancer genomes identified by a next-generation sequencing-based approach (PMID: 23236287)
biological.summary: ADAM21 was one of the genes targeted by HBV integration in HBV-related HCC. It is listed among genes containing the EGF-like conserved site domain (IPR013032).
